data.name: Kursk - Battle at Prochorovka
data.detailed_description:
A fan of WW2 strategy war games? Like to think about your next move rather than having quick reaction times? Battle Series Eastern Front - Kursk - Battle at Prochorovka is the game for you.

Battle Series Eastern Front - Kursk - Battle at Prochorovka, covers one of largest single tank battle in the history of warfare. Approximately 1000 tanks and assault guns met head to head near the town of Prochorovka, in a battle that became a desperate close range shoot-out which would decide the ultimate success or failure of Operation Zitadelle.

The 2nd SS Panzer Korps began it's attack on July 3rd, and spent the next 8 days breaking through the dense Russian defensive positions. During the late afternoon and evening of the 11th, they broke through and repulsed a counterattack by the Russian 31st Tank Corps. Reorganizing during the night, the panzers struck northward before dawn on the 12th. As dawn broke, the lead German elements ran head-on into the lead elements of the Soviet 5th Guards Tank Army and the battle was on. It was to last all day, in confused and savage fighting at close ranges.

This game recreates that day with the player being able to play both as the Russians and Germans or against the AI. Go to for the latest news and support.



  • Turn Based with each turn having a Move and Attack phase
  • Units are at battalion level and represent the units present on the day of the battle
  • Units have an Attack, Defense and Movement Allowance
  • Artillery units also have a Range allowance
  • Map represents the key features at the time with the embanked railway line and river causing the fighting to be fought almost as three separate battles
  • Play as the Germans against the Computer AI
  • Three scenario variants

reviews.review:
while i spend most of my time testing games now days, i still enjoy playing them in my own time, so this caught my eye once a friend had posted it on there wishlist, plays like almost any war game you own, so simple to pick up and play, manual is in game, so again, all is there at hand if and when needed, programmed in Java, it's a quick game as in it loads in an instance, turns are rapid, but this isn't to say it's a short game, that's your playstyle and how you wish to play it, works on windows 10 with nothing needed straight out of the box as they say, so simple to setup and install and play, so a bonus.

game play is phased based, so you move, then once all your units have moved, you enter a combat phase, then once done, you either swap seats and let your mate play, or later on it's single player so you can one day play against the AI, as it's EA, not everything is in at the start, but what's in now puts many AAA titles to shame, eg it works, it's stable and it's fun and plays well on release as it's only been out a day 10th March 2017.

game play wise, it's like more than a few others i already own, but while it looks a simple type game, it has some depth, but as it's EA and atm no AI, it's impossiable to also comment on what it's like or will be like later on, so that's for a updated review when the times comes.

would i recommned it?

as it is atm, and i'm really only a game tester, who dislikes online games btw, and doesn't own or play any board games any longer, but loves a good war game, from any period in history, even without single player in atm, it's a YES.

iv'e uploaded 20 odd screenshots and there will be more, so make your own mind up, and support the war game makers, as we all know, there isn't that many left and those who are still doing them, are getting older, and over time, there will be ever less, at this price, it's a bargin and well worth double the price for the value and time it will give you for another good war game that's been done well.
